footnote_text: The Reporting Person was granted 20,000 restricted stock units under the Issuer's 2020 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, as amended, in recognition of service on the Board of Directors, which vested in full on the date of grant, immediately prior to the Reporting Person's resignation from the Board of Directors effective October 19, 2026. Each restricted stock unit represents the right to receive one share of common stock.
